index.h1: Mufeed Tools: Today's Date, Jantri and Free Online Tools
index.lead: Everyday jobs on your phone in seconds: check the date, work out your age, measure a plot, count your tasbeeh.
index.calIntro: Above you will find today's Gregorian, Hijri and Desi (Bikrami) date, moon phase, auspicious and inauspicious hours, zodiac sign and special days in one place. Tap a date to open the whole month.
why: Every tool is free and needs no sign-up.
The names, numbers and dates you type stay in your browser.
In Urdu, Arabic and English, built for phones.
Made with Pakistani needs in mind: marla, kanal, Desi months and the Hijri date.

faq.a: Today's Hijri date is shown in the box at the top of the home page. It follows the Saudi (Umm al-Qura) calendar, so it can differ by a day from moon sighting in your country; use the adjustment option to match it.
Yes, every tool is free and you do not need an account.
What you type into the tools is used inside your browser and is not stored on our servers. Details are in the privacy policy.

faq.q: Are the horoscope and fortune readings real?
faq.a: No, they are for fun only. Please do not base any decision on them.

faq.q: Can I message a number on WhatsApp without saving it?
faq.a: Yes. In the WhatsApp direct tool, choose the country code, type the number and open the chat.
